text: Cultivate the inner fire, but avoid a fire! Energy is fuel. Directed toward a goal, it becomes a driving force. Dispersed into anger, anxiety and irritation, it burns you from within. Not only psychic structures but also the gastrointestinal tract are in danger. Problems with GIT health clearly indicate that you are managing energy destructively - destroying your life rather than creating. Learn to concentrate energy on positive action, and not on destructive emotional outbursts.
